verdict.rationale: Airbyte docs and GitHub repeatedly describe 'Airbyte Core' as its open source product with source available on GitHub (airbyte-docs-12/16/31/37, airbyte-gh-1), which supports the read-source claim. However, a hands-on community report concretely disputes the 'fully open source' framing, describing it as freemium with locked/non-free parts (e.g., security features) that users are not permitted to use (airbyte-comm-2). missing for 10: explicit license name/OSI status in evidence, clarification of which modules are proprietary vs open, and independent confirmation resolving the freemium dispute.
